note: Human-facing program names for (college, TOP6), found via the find-program-name skill (regionalcte.org-anchored, college-catalog-confirmed) and link-verified against each program's canonical page on the college's own site. The report renders names[key].name in place of the state CIP/TOP6 name; ANY (college,TOP6) not present here falls back to the CIP name from the graph. verified: opened = page fetched live and the name read on it; indexed = page is Cloudflare/JS-blocked to direct fetch, name confirmed via the search engine's index of that exact URL. confidence high = name read on the college's own canonical page; medium = name correct but the program was rebranded / multi-credential ambiguity (eyeball before shipping). Refresh/extend via the find-program-name skill. Key format: '<exact graph college name>|<TOP6>'.

The CIP label misleads keyword search — this was the find-program-name false-negative; corrected from regionalcte.org/browse/4nbg2 + the college catalog.

Foothill College|094600.name: Air Conditioning Mechanic
Foothill College|094600.note: regionalcte.org/browse/ZRdJO explicitly ties TOP 094600 to Foothill's 'Certificate of Achievement in Air Conditioning Mechanic' (5-yr sheet-metal/HVAC apprenticeship; Cert + AS). A sibling program 'Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Technology' (catalog.foothill.edu/degrees-certificates/apprenticeship-air-conditioning-refrigeration-technology/) shares the 094600 HVAC family — if the report wants the broader HVACR brand, swap to it. San Jose City College|094600.name: Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Technology
San Jose City College|094600.note: Confirmed on SJCC's CourseLeaf catalog (AS + Certificates of Achievement Level 2 & 3). regionalcte.org snippets did not cleanly surface this pair, but it is the single unambiguous 094600 program. ACTIVE — DataMart 094600 conferrals e.g. 29/14/31/36 across three program rows; no false-negative risk.

Laney College|094600.name: Environmental Control Technology (HVACR)
Laney College|094600.note: Laney brands this as 'Environmental Control Technology' (ECT, HVAC&R) with several tracks — Residential & Light Commercial HVAC&R, Commercial HVAC, Building Automation Systems, Refrigeration — each AS + Certificate of Achievement. Brand ~= state label. ACTIVE — DataMart 094600 conferrals e.g. 10/5/12/25; no false-negative risk.

Gavilan College|094600.name: HVAC - Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning
Gavilan College|094600.note: Gavilan's HVAC program page (www.gavilan.edu/academic/hvac/, fetched live) heads as 'Heating, Air Conditioning, and Ventilation'; the degree-list (hhh.gavilan.edu/phowell/deg/programs_standalone.php) brands the AS as 'HVAC - Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning' with Certificate of Achievement + short-term certs. Clean 094600 HVAC family (Foothill sibling). regionalcte.org did NOT surface a clean 094600/Gavilan record (its index returned the college's own pages); TOP↔name link inferred but name read directly on the college's authoritative pages. ACTIVE — recent awards 9/7/22 over last three years; no false-negative risk.

Foothill College|121000.name: Respiratory Therapy
Foothill College|121000.note: Catalog heading reads 'Respiratory Therapy' — AS (100 major units) + Certificate of Achievement in Interventional Pulmonology Assistant (12 units). CoARC program 200017. Foothill ALSO offers a separate Bachelor of Science in Respiratory Care (catalog.foothill.edu/degrees-certificates/respiratory-care/) for holders of a CoARC-accredited AS — note the college uses 'Therapy' for the AS brand and 'Care' for the BS.

Skyline College|121000.name: Respiratory Care
Skyline College|121000.note: Catalog heading reads 'Respiratory Care Associate in Science Degree Program'. CoARC program 200147. Skyline also offers a Bachelor of Science in Respiratory Care (catalog.skylinecollege.edu/current/programs/respiratory-care-bs.php) — one of the CCC baccalaureate programs.

Napa Valley College|121000.name: Respiratory Care
Napa Valley College|121000.note: Catalog heading reads 'Respiratory Care: AS Degree'. Internally inconsistent on the college's own site — the area-of-study and program page say 'Respiratory Care' while the course prefix (RESP) and some prose say 'Respiratory Therapy'; the program/catalog heading is the brand used here.

Foothill College|010210.name: Veterinary Technology
Foothill College|010210.note: Catalog heading reads 'Veterinary Technology'; award types listed as AS + Certificate of Achievement. AVMA-CVTEA accredited, VTNE pass rate 89% / job placement 100% (2023-2025). State TOP label says 'Technician', the college says 'Technology'.

Santa Rosa Junior College|010210.name: Veterinary Technician
Santa Rosa Junior College|010210.note: SRJC brands it 'Veterinary Technician' (Certificate) within the Agriculture & Natural Resources Dept; courses meet CA Registered Veterinary Technician requirements via the Alternate Route. Name matches the state label closely; TOP link inferred by subject, not read off regionalcte.org.

City College of San Francisco|126100.name: Community Health Worker
City College of San Francisco|126100.note: CCSF brands it 'Community Health Worker' (CHW Certificate, 2 semesters, cohort model). SF Dept of Public Health accepts the certificate as 6 of the 12 months experience for its Health Worker 1-3 series.

Berkeley City College|126100.name: Community Health Worker
Berkeley City College|126100.note: BCC runs a free NONCREDIT Community Health Worker Certificate (105 hours) plus a CHW Apprenticeship, housed in Social Work & Human Services. Noncredit delivery means DataMart award counts may not represent the full throughput.

Cabrillo College|126100.name: Community Health Worker
Cabrillo College|126100.note: Cabrillo brands it 'Community Health Worker' (Certificate of Achievement, 16 units, ~2 semesters, IBEST co-teaching model); pairs with a DOL/DAS-registered CHW apprenticeship.

Foothill College|126100.name: Community Health Worker
Foothill College|126100.note: Foothill brands it 'Community Health Worker' (Certificate of Achievement, 12 units, 9 months), housed in Public & Community Health. Distinct from Foothill's TOP 120100 'Health Occupations, General' — see the report's _programs_note for why the CHW report uses THIS program rather than the larger generic one.

Mission College|126100.name: Community Health Worker
Mission College|126100.note: Mission brands it 'Community Health Worker' — a NONCREDIT Certificate of Completion from Health Occupations (no tuition/fees). Noncredit delivery caveat as with Berkeley City.

Foothill College|010900.name: Environmental Horticulture and Design
Foothill College|010900.note: The largest brand gap in this batch: the state TOP label is the bare word 'Horticulture', but Foothill markets the department and the program as 'Environmental Horticulture & Design' (AS + two Certificates of Achievement). Career list spans arboriculture, landscape construction/design, park and golf-course management.

Cabrillo College|010900.name: Horticulture
Cabrillo College|010900.note: Cabrillo keeps the plain 'Horticulture' brand but with unusual breadth — 10 certificates and 5 associate degrees, including an AS in Landscape Horticulture and an AS in General Horticulture and Crop Production. Brand == state label here.

Merritt College|010900.name: Landscape Horticulture
Merritt College|010900.note: Merritt runs BOTH 010900 and 010910 under one department brand, 'Landscape Horticulture' — so this entry and Merritt College|010910 carry the same name by design, not by duplication. Offerings span Nursery Management AS, Arboriculture AS, Tree Care / Tree Climber Specialist CAs, and a Basic Cannabis Horticulture CA.

Solano Community College|010900.name: Horticulture Science
Solano Community College|010900.note: Solano brands the credential 'Horticulture Science' (AS + Certificate of Achievement, 23 core units), with six specialized Ornamental Horticulture areas beneath it. The state label is the bare 'Horticulture'.

Diablo Valley College|010900.name: Horticulture
Diablo Valley College|010900.note: DVC keeps the plain 'Horticulture' brand: AS-T Agriculture Plant Science plus Certificates of Achievement in plant science and horticulture and Certificates of Accomplishment in nursery technician and horticulture technician. Brand == state label.

Las Positas College|010900.name: Horticulture
Las Positas College|010900.note: LPC keeps the plain 'Horticulture' brand: AS plus Certificates of Achievement in Ornamental Horticulture, Landscape Maintenance & Construction, Landscape Design, and Nursery/Greenhouse/Grower Operations. Brand == state label.

Diablo Valley College|126100.name: Community Health Worker
Diablo Valley College|126100.note: DVC brands it 'Community Health Worker' (two-semester, 16-unit certificate with an internship), housed in Public Health — the only college-credit CHW program in Contra Costa County. Affiliated with the California Association of Community Health Workers.

Merritt College|010910.name: Landscape Horticulture
Merritt College|010910.note: Merritt brands the department and program 'Landscape Horticulture' (state label is 'Landscape Design and Maintenance'). Offerings include Arboriculture AS, Basic Landscape Horticulture CA, Tree Care Specialist and Tree Climber Specialist CAs, and a Basic Cannabis Horticulture CA.

Santa Rosa Junior College|010910.name: Environmental Horticulture: Landscape Design
Santa Rosa Junior College|010910.note: SRJC files landscape design under its Environmental Horticulture program as 'Environmental Horticulture: Landscape Design' (Certificate of Achievement), in the Agriculture/Natural Resources Dept.

Ohlone College|121000.note: Page title 'Respiratory Therapist Program'; body reads 'Respiratory Therapist Degree — Associate in Science (A.S.) Degree'.
